gaps.description: `when Variant with field` binds payloads but cannot test them against a constant; nested patterns need an if inside the branch.

The doc shows no catch-all `when` line and says missing cases are compile errors, so every other variant had to be listed by name, each repeating `give back nothing`; this also breaks if Token gains variants.
No reverse iteration form; written as an index loop with item (count - 1 - k).
The vocabulary table has no append operation; `append value to list` appears only once, in example 9, with no stated allocation behaviour.

notes: The control flow (early exits from inside a match inside a loop) translates cleanly; `give back` and `stop` inside `choose` inside `for each` read well. The main friction is the lack of a wildcard `when` and of nested literal patterns, which together turned a 3-arm match into a 9-arm one. Allocation becoming visible adds `uses memory` and OutOfMemory to a function whose Rust signature promises neither.
